<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover">
<title>Just Do It: brand study prototype</title>
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Archivo:wdth,wght@62..125,100..900&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
:root{
  --ink:#111111;--paper:#F4F4F1;--volt:#CEFF00;--ash:#8C8C8A;
  --pad:clamp(20px,4vw,56px);
  --ease:cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.1,1);
  --font:Archivo,"Helvetica Neue",Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif;
}
*{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0}
[hidden]{display:none!important}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth}
body{background:var(--ink);color:var(--paper);font-family:var(--font);-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;overflow-x:hidden}
a,button,input,output{font:inherit;color:inherit}
a{text-decoration:none}
button{cursor:pointer}
:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--volt);outline-offset:4px}

@keyframes rise{from{opacity:0;transform:translate3d(0,36px,0)}to{opacity:1;transform:none}}
@keyframes sh{to{transform:translateX(100%)}}

/* Intro loader */
#intro{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:200;background:var(--ink);color:var(--volt);display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:space-between;padding:var(--pad);transition:clip-path 1s var(--ease)}
#intro.out{clip-path:inset(0 0 100% 0)}
#intro .row{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;font-size:15px;font-weight:600}
#intro .n{font-size:clamp(120px,24vw,360px);font-weight:900;font-stretch:112%;line-height:.8;letter-spacing:-.05em;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
#intro .bw{display:block;height:3px;background:rgba(206,255,0,.2)}
#intro .bar{display:block;height:100%;background:var(--volt);transform:scaleX(0);transform-origin:left}

/* Nav */
.nav{position:fixed;inset:0 0 auto 0;z-index:50;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:24px;flex-wrap:wrap;padding:22px var(--pad);color:#fff;mix-blend-mode:difference}
.nav .brand{font-weight:900;font-size:18px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:-.01em}
.nav ul{display:flex;gap:28px;list-style:none;flex-wrap:wrap}
.nav a{font-size:14px;font-weight:600}
.nav a:hover,.nav a[aria-current="page"]{text-decoration:underline;text-underline-offset:6px}

/* Buttons */
.btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;padding:22px 40px;border:3px solid var(--volt);border-radius:999px;background:var(--volt);color:var(--ink);font-size:18px;font-weight:700;transition:transform .45s var(--ease),background-color .3s,color .3s}
.btn:hover{background:transparent;color:var(--volt)}
.btn-dark{border-color:var(--ink);background:var(--ink);color:var(--volt)}
.btn-dark:hover{background:transparent;color:var(--ink)}

/* Home: hero */
.hero{position:relative;min-height:100vh;min-height:100svh;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:flex-end;padding:var(--pad);padding-bottom:calc(var(--pad)*1.1);overflow:hidden}
.motion{position:absolute;left:0;top:14%;width:100%;height:auto;pointer-events:none}
.motion path{fill:none;stroke:var(--volt);stroke-width:7;stroke-linecap:round}
.hero-title{font-size:clamp(64px,17.5vw,300px);font-weight:900;font-stretch:125%;line-height:.8;letter-spacing:-.035em;text-transform:uppercase}
.line{display:block;overflow:hidden;padding-bottom:.06em}
.line>span{display:inline-block;transform:translate3d(0,108%,0);transition:transform 1.2s var(--ease)}
.line+.line>span{transition-delay:.12s}
.ready .line>span{transform:none}
.hero-foot{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:flex-end;gap:32px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:clamp(28px,4vw,56px)}
.hero-sub{max-width:34ch;font-size:clamp(17px,1.6vw,21px);line-height:1.45;color:#D0D0CC}

/* Marquee */
.marquee{background:var(--volt);color:var(--ink);overflow:hidden;padding:clamp(14px,2vw,22px) 0;white-space:nowrap}
.track{display:inline-flex;will-change:transform;font-size:clamp(30px,4.6vw,72px);font-weight:800;font-stretch:112%;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:-.015em;line-height:1}
.track span{padding-right:.5em}
.track span::after{content:"";display:inline-block;width:.36em;height:.36em;margin-left:.5em;background:var(--ink);vertical-align:.14em}

/* Statement */
.statement{padding:clamp(120px,18vw,260px) var(--pad)}
.statement p{max-width:24ch;font-size:clamp(38px,5.8vw,100px);font-weight:800;line-height:1.02;letter-spacing:-.03em}

/* Join */
.join{background:var(--volt);color:var(--ink);padding:clamp(120px,16vw,220px) var(--pad);display:grid;gap:clamp(36px,5vw,60px);justify-items:start}
.join h2{font-size:clamp(56px,9vw,156px);font-weight:900;line-height:.84;letter-spacing:-.035em;text-transform:uppercase;max-width:11ch}

/* Sessions: pinned rail */
.sessions{height:300vh;position:relative;background:var(--ink)}
.pin{position:sticky;top:0;height:100vh;height:100svh;overflow:hidden}
.rail{display:flex;width:300vw;height:100%;will-change:transform}
.panel{flex:0 0 100vw;height:100%;padding:var(--pad);padding-bottom:calc(var(--pad)*1.2);display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:flex-end}
.panel h2{font-size:clamp(72px,15vw,260px);font-weight:900;font-stretch:112%;line-height:.8;letter-spacing:-.04em;text-transform:uppercase}
.panel p{max-width:34ch;margin-top:clamp(20px,3vw,40px);font-size:clamp(17px,1.7vw,24px);line-height:1.4}
.p-ink{background:var(--ink);color:var(--paper)}
.p-volt{background:var(--volt);color:var(--ink)}
.p-paper{background:var(--paper);color:var(--ink)}

/* Pace */
.pace{background:var(--paper);color:var(--ink);padding:140px var(--pad) clamp(96px,14vw,200px);display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:clamp(40px,6vw,104px);align-items:end;min-height:100vh}
.pace h2{font-size:clamp(52px,8vw,128px);font-weight:900;line-height:.82;letter-spacing:-.035em;text-transform:uppercase}
.calc{display:grid;gap:clamp(24px,3vw,36px)}
.times{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:24px}
.field{display:grid;gap:10px}
.field label,.out-label{font-size:15px;font-weight:600}
.field input{width:100%;border:0;border-bottom:3px solid var(--ink);border-radius:0;background:transparent;padding:8px 0 10px;font-size:clamp(30px,3.6vw,48px);font-weight:700;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;color:var(--ink)}
.field input:focus{outline:none;background:var(--volt)}
.results{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:24px;padding-top:clamp(20px,3vw,36px);border-top:3px solid var(--ink)}
.result{display:block;margin-top:10px;font-size:clamp(56px,7.6vw,120px);font-weight:900;line-height:.9;letter-spacing:-.04em;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}

/* Brand palette */
.palette{background:var(--ink);color:var(--paper);padding:140px var(--pad) clamp(96px,12vw,180px);min-height:100vh}
.palette h2{font-size:clamp(44px,6vw,96px);font-weight:900;line-height:.88;letter-spacing:-.03em;text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:clamp(40px,5vw,72px);max-width:14ch}
.swatches{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(200px,1fr))}
.sw{appearance:none;border:0;border-radius:0;text-align:left;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:space-between;gap:48px;min-height:260px;padding:24px;background:var(--c);color:var(--fg)}
.sw:active{transform:scale(.98)}
.sw span{font-size:20px;font-weight:700}
.sw small{font-size:15px;font-weight:600;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;opacity:.85}
.note{margin-top:24px;min-height:1.5em;font-size:15px;color:var(--ash)}

/* Shop: category index + grid */
.shop{display:grid;grid-template-columns:240px 1fr;background:var(--paper);color:var(--ink);min-height:100vh;padding-top:120px}
.side{position:sticky;top:120px;align-self:start;padding:0 0 var(--pad) var(--pad)}
.side button{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;width:100%;padding:11px 0;background:none;border:0;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(17,17,17,.15);font-size:16px;font-weight:600;text-align:left;color:#666}
.side button:hover,.side button[aria-pressed="true"]{color:var(--ink)}
.side button[aria-pressed="true"]{font-weight:800;border-bottom-color:var(--ink)}
.shop-main{padding:0 var(--pad) var(--pad)}
.shop-h{font-size:clamp(56px,9vw,160px);font-weight:900;font-stretch:112%;line-height:.82;letter-spacing:-.04em;text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:40px}
.grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(200px,1fr));gap:18px}
.card{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:14px;min-height:300px;padding:14px;background:var(--ink);color:var(--paper);animation:rise .7s var(--ease) backwards;animation-delay:calc(var(--i,0)*40ms);transition:transform .5s var(--ease)}
.card:hover{--lift:-6px;--gl:1}
.card .idx{flex:1;min-height:160px;padding:12px;background:var(--volt);color:var(--ink);font-size:clamp(48px,5vw,76px);font-weight:900;line-height:1;letter-spacing:-.03em;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.card h3{font-size:19px;font-weight:700}
.card p{margin-top:2px;font-size:13px;color:#BDBDB9}

/* Loading placeholders with shadow beneath */
.ph{position:relative;overflow:hidden;background:#E2E2DE;box-shadow:0 26px 24px -16px rgba(17,17,17,.45)}
.ph::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(100deg,transparent 30%,rgba(255,255,255,.75) 50%,transparent 70%);transform:translateX(-100%);animation:sh 1.4s infinite}
.card.ph{background:#E2E2DE;color:transparent;animation:none;transform:none;min-height:300px}

/* Product page */
#pd{background:var(--paper);color:var(--ink);min-height:100vh}
.pd-skel{min-height:100vh}
.pd-top{background:var(--volt);padding:150px var(--pad) var(--pad);min-height:72vh;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:flex-end}
.pd-meta{display:flex;gap:28px;font-size:15px;font-weight:600;margin-bottom:20px}
.pd-name{font-size:clamp(64px,13vw,220px);font-weight:900;font-stretch:112%;line-height:.82;letter-spacing:-.04em;text-transform:uppercase;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.pd-body{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:clamp(32px,5vw,80px);padding:var(--pad)}
.pd-blurb{font-size:clamp(22px,2.6vw,36px);line-height:1.25;font-weight:700;max-width:24ch}
.pd-note{font-size:16px;line-height:1.5;color:#444;margin-bottom:28px;max-width:40ch}
.pd-nav{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:20px;flex-wrap:wrap;padding:24px var(--pad);border-top:2px solid var(--ink);border-bottom:2px solid var(--ink);font-weight:700}
.rel{padding:var(--pad)}
.rel h2{font-size:clamp(40px,5vw,84px);font-weight:900;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:-.03em;line-height:.9;margin-bottom:32px}
.rel .card{background:var(--ink)}
.pd-in{animation:rise .9s var(--ease) backwards}

/* 3D sneaker in the hero */
.shoe{position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:1;pointer-events:none;opacity:0;transition:opacity 1.2s var(--ease) .4s}
.ready .shoe{opacity:1}
.shoe canvas{display:block;width:100%;height:100%}
.hero-title,.hero-foot{position:relative;z-index:2}

/* Product art, cart, drag feedback */
.card .pic{display:block;padding:14px;background:var(--paper);touch-action:none;-webkit-user-drag:none}
.card .meta{display:grid;gap:8px}
.card .n{font-size:13px;font-weight:700;color:var(--volt)}
.card h3 a{color:inherit}
.shoe-art{display:block;width:100%;height:auto;pointer-events:none;user-select:none}
.pd-art{background:var(--paper);padding:18px;width:min(520px,80vw);margin-bottom:28px}
.pd-art svg{display:block;width:100%;height:auto;pointer-events:none}
.add{justify-self:start;margin-top:6px;padding:10px 16px;border:2px solid var(--volt);border-radius:999px;background:transparent;color:var(--volt);font-size:14px;font-weight:700;transition:background-color .25s,color .25s}
.add:hover{background:var(--volt);color:var(--ink)}
.fly{position:fixed;left:0;top:0;z-index:150;pointer-events:none;padding:8px;background:var(--paper);box-shadow:0 18px 30px -12px rgba(0,0,0,.5)}
.fly svg{display:block;width:100%;height:auto}
.cart{position:fixed;right:var(--pad);bottom:var(--pad);z-index:90;display:grid;justify-items:end;gap:12px}
.cart-btn{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:14px 20px;border:3px solid var(--volt);border-radius:999px;background:var(--volt);color:var(--ink);font-size:16px;font-weight:700;transition:background-color .3s,color .3s,box-shadow .3s}
.cart-btn svg{width:22px;height:22px;fill:none;stroke:currentColor;stroke-width:2;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round}
.cart-btn.over{background:var(--ink);color:var(--volt);box-shadow:0 0 0 8px rgba(206,255,0,.35)}
.badge{min-width:28px;height:28px;display:inline-grid;place-items:center;padding:0 7px;border-radius:999px;background:var(--ink);color:var(--volt);font-size:14px;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.cart-panel{width:min(320px,86vw);max-height:50vh;overflow:auto;background:var(--ink);color:var(--paper);border:2px solid var(--volt);border-radius:16px;padding:18px}
.cart-panel ul{list-style:none;display:grid;gap:12px}
.cart-panel li{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr auto auto;gap:10px;align-items:center;font-size:15px}
.cart-panel li button{background:none;border:0;color:var(--volt);font-size:13px;font-weight:600;text-decoration:underline}
#cart-empty,#cart-total{font-size:14px;color:#BDBDB9}
#cart-total{margin-top:12px;color:var(--volt);font-weight:700}
.toast{position:fixed;left:50%;bottom:calc(var(--pad) + 84px);z-index:95;padding:12px 18px;background:var(--volt);color:var(--ink);font-weight:700;font-size:15px;white-space:nowrap;opacity:0;pointer-events:none;transform:translate(-50%,0)}
.toast.show{animation:toast 2.4s var(--ease) both}
@keyframes toast{0%{opacity:0;transform:translate(-50%,24px)}12%,80%{opacity:1;transform:translate(-50%,0)}100%{opacity:0;transform:translate(-50%,-8px)}}

.shoe-status{position:absolute;z-index:3;left:var(--pad);bottom:calc(var(--pad)*4);font-size:13px;color:var(--ash)}

/* Added: progress bar, split headings, card tilt and glare, view transitions */
.progress{position:fixed;top:0;left:0;right:0;height:3px;background:var(--volt);transform-origin:left;transform:scaleX(0);z-index:60}
[data-split]{overflow:hidden;padding-bottom:.08em}
.ch{display:inline-block;transform:translate3d(0,105%,0);transition:transform 1s var(--ease) var(--d,0ms)}
[data-split].in .ch{transform:none}
.card{transform:perspective(800px) rotateX(var(--rx,0deg)) rotateY(var(--ry,0deg)) translateY(var(--lift,0px));position:relative;overflow:hidden;transition:transform .45s var(--ease)}
.card::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;pointer-events:none;background:radial-gradient(circle at var(--mx,50%) var(--my,50%),rgba(255,255,255,.2),transparent 55%);opacity:var(--gl,0);transition:opacity .3s}
::view-transition-old(root),::view-transition-new(root){animation-duration:.7s}
::view-transition-new(root){animation-name:vt-in}
@keyframes vt-in{from{clip-path:inset(100% 0 0 0)}to{clip-path:inset(0 0 0 0)}}

/* Footer */
footer{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;padding:32px var(--pad);font-size:14px;color:var(--ash)}

@media (max-width:820px){
  .shop{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .side{position:static;display:flex;overflow-x:auto;padding:0 var(--pad);border-bottom:1px solid rgba(17,17,17,.15)}
  .side button{flex:0 0 auto;width:auto;border-bottom:0;padding:14px 16px 14px 0;white-space:nowrap}
  .panel p,.pace{font-size:inherit}
  .pace,.pd-body{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .times,.results{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .swatches{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}
  .nav ul{gap:16px}
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){
  html{scroll-behavior:auto}
  *,*::before,*::after{transition:none!important;animation:none!important}
  .line>span{transform:none}
  .sessions{height:auto}
  .pin{position:static;height:auto}
  .rail{width:auto;flex-direction:column;transform:none!important}
  .panel{flex:none;min-height:80vh}
}
</style>
</head>
<body>

<div id="intro" aria-hidden="true">
  <div class="row"><span>Just Do It</span><span>Loading</span></div>
  <span class="n" id="cnt">000</span>
  <span class="bw"><span class="bar" id="bar"></span></span>
</div>

<nav class="nav" aria-label="Main">
  <a class="brand" href="#home">Just Do It</a>
  <ul>
    <li><a href="#shop" data-tab="shop">Shop</a></li>
    <li><a href="#sessions" data-tab="sessions">Sessions</a></li>
    <li><a href="#pace" data-tab="pace">Pace</a></li>
    <li><a href="#brand" data-tab="brand">Brand</a></li>
  </ul>
</nav>

<main data-view="home">
  <header class="hero">
    <div class="shoe" id="shoe" aria-hidden="true"></div>
    <p class="shoe-status" id="shoe-status"></p>
    <svg class="motion" viewBox="0 0 1200 320" aria-hidden="true">
      <path id="stroke" d="M-20 270 C 260 60, 520 330, 760 150 S 1110 40, 1220 120"/>
    </svg>
    <h1 class="hero-title">
      <span class="line"><span>Just</span></span>
      <span class="line"><span>Do it</span></span>
    </h1>
    <div class="hero-foot">
      <p class="hero-sub">Training plans, pace tools, and the discipline to show up for the first kilometre and the last one.</p>
      <a class="btn" href="#pace" data-mag>Check your pace</a>
    </div>
  </header>
  <div class="marquee" aria-hidden="true">
    <div class="track"><span>Run</span><span>Lift</span><span>Recover</span><span>Repeat</span><span>Run</span><span>Lift</span><span>Recover</span><span>Repeat</span></div>
  </div>
  <section class="statement" aria-label="Manifesto">
    <p id="statement">Every long run starts as a short walk to the corner. Nobody arrives at the finish by accident, and nobody arrives alone.</p>
  </section>
  <section class="join">
    <h2 data-split>Start tomorrow. Or now, if you can.</h2>
    <a class="btn btn-dark" href="#shop" data-mag>Browse the shop</a>
  </section>
</main>

<main data-view="shop" hidden>
  <div class="shop">
    <aside class="side" id="side" aria-label="Product categories"></aside>
    <div class="shop-main">
      <h1 class="shop-h" id="shop-title">All</h1>
      <div class="grid" id="grid"></div>
    </div>
  </div>
</main>

<main data-view="product" id="pd" hidden></main>

<main data-view="sessions" hidden>
  <section class="sessions">
    <div class="pin">
      <div class="rail">
        <article class="panel p-ink">
          <h2>Run.</h2>
          <p>Intervals on Tuesday, tempo on Thursday, and a long slow Sunday nobody photographs. The plan bends around the week you actually had.</p>
        </article>
        <article class="panel p-volt">
          <h2>Lift.</h2>
          <p>Strength is a habit before it is a number. Short sessions, heavy enough to matter, built to fit between everything else.</p>
        </article>
        <article class="panel p-paper">
          <h2>Recover.</h2>
          <p>Sleep, mobility, the walk home. Recovery is training too, and the plan treats it that way.</p>
        </article>
      </div>
    </div>
  </section>
</main>

<main data-view="pace" hidden>
  <section class="pace">
    <h2 data-split>Know your pace.</h2>
    <div class="calc">
      <div class="field">
        <label for="dist">Distance (km)</label>
        <input id="dist" type="number" min="0" step="0.01" value="10" inputmode="decimal">
      </div>
      <div class="times">
        <div class="field">
          <label for="mins">Minutes</label>
          <input id="mins" type="number" min="0" value="50" inputmode="numeric">
        </div>
        <div class="field">
          <label for="secs">Seconds</label>
          <input id="secs" type="number" min="0" max="59" value="0" inputmode="numeric">
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="results">
        <div>
          <p class="out-label">Pace per km</p>
          <output id="pace-out" for="dist mins secs" class="result" aria-live="polite">5:00</output>
        </div>
        <div>
          <p class="out-label">Speed, km/h</p>
          <output id="speed-out" for="dist mins secs" class="result" aria-live="polite">12.0</output>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </section>
</main>

<main data-view="brand" hidden>
  <section class="palette">
    <h2 data-split>Four colors, one loud.</h2>
    <div class="swatches">
      <button class="sw" type="button" data-hex="#111111" style="--c:#111111;--fg:#F4F4F1"><span>Ink</span><small>#111111</small></button>
      <button class="sw" type="button" data-hex="#F4F4F1" style="--c:#F4F4F1;--fg:#111111"><span>Paper</span><small>#F4F4F1</small></button>
      <button class="sw" type="button" data-hex="#CEFF00" style="--c:#CEFF00;--fg:#111111"><span>Volt</span><small>#CEFF00</small></button>
      <button class="sw" type="button" data-hex="#8C8C8A" style="--c:#8C8C8A;--fg:#111111"><span>Ash</span><small>#8C8C8A</small></button>
    </div>
    <p class="note" id="copied" aria-live="polite">Click a color to copy its hex. Volt is not confirmed against an official source.</p>
  </section>
</main>

<div class="cart">
  <div class="cart-panel" id="cart-panel" hidden>
    <ul id="cart-list"></ul>
    <p id="cart-empty">Drag a product image here, or press Add to cart.</p>
    <p id="cart-total"></p>
  </div>
  <button class="cart-btn" id="cart-btn" type="button" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="cart-panel">
    <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M3 4h2l2.4 10.2a2 2 0 0 0 2 1.6h7.9a2 2 0 0 0 2-1.5L21 8H6.1"/><circle cx="9.5" cy="20" r="1.5"/><circle cx="17" cy="20" r="1.5"/></svg>
    <span>Cart</span><span class="badge" id="badge">0</span>
  </button>
</div>
<div class="toast" id="toast" role="status" aria-live="polite"></div>
<footer>
  <p>Brand study prototype. Not an official Nike site and not affiliated with Nike, Inc.</p>
  <p>Catalog is illustrative. No prices or availability.</p>
  <p>3D model "Nike TC 7900 Sail" by <a style="color:inherit" href="https://sketchfab.com/SofiaWolfie">SofiaWolfie</a> on Sketchfab, <a style="color:inherit" href="http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/">CC BY 4.0</a>. Modified: textures reduced to 1024 px and indices to 16 bit.</p>
</footer>

<script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/three.js/r128/three.min.js"></script>
<script id="glb" type="text/plain"></script>
<script>
(() => {
  const $ = (s, c = document) => c.querySelector(s);
  const $$ = (s, c = document) => [...c.querySelectorAll(s)];
  const clamp = (v, a = 0, b = 1) => Math.min(b, Math.max(a, v));
  const reduce = matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;
  const fine = matchMedia('(hover:hover) and (pointer:fine)').matches && !reduce;

  // Catalog: [category, code, models separated by |, category blurb]
  const DATA = [
    ['Running', 'run', 'Pegasus 42|Vomero|Alphafly 3|Vaporfly 3|Invincible 3|Structure 25|Streakfly|Infinity Run 4|Free RN 5|Winflo 11', 'Built for the road: daily miles, tempo days and race-day effort.'],
    ['Basketball', 'bb', 'G.T. Cut 3|Ja 2|Kyrie 8|LeBron 22|KD 17|Giannis Immortality 4|Sabrina 2|Kobe 9 Elite', 'Court support for quick cuts, hard stops and hard landings.'],
    ['Jordan', 'jor', 'Air Jordan 1 High|Air Jordan 1 Low|Air Jordan 3|Air Jordan 4|Air Jordan 11', 'Heritage silhouettes from the Jordan line, for the court and the street.'],
    ['Football', 'fb', 'Mercurial Vapor 16|Mercurial Superfly 10|Phantom GX 2|Tiempo Legend 10', 'Traction and touch for the pitch, from training to match day.'],
    ['Training', 'tr', 'Metcon 9|Free Metcon 6|Air Zoom TR 1|Free TR 2', 'A stable base for lifting, circuits and cross training.'],
    ['Streetwear', 'st', "Air Force 1 '07|Air Max 90|Air Max 1|Air Max Plus|Blazer Mid '77|Dunk Low|Cortez|Court Vision Low", 'Classic lines for everyday wear.'],
    ['Sportswear', 'sw', 'Tech Fleece Hoodie|Club Fleece Crew|Club Fleece Joggers|Sportswear Essentials Hoodie|Tech Fleece Pants|Dri-FIT Tee|Dri-FIT Running Shorts|Windrunner Jacket|Graphic Tee', 'Apparel for training, travel and days off.'],
    ['Skate', 'sk', 'SB Dunk Low|SB Force 58|SB Janoski+|SB Chron 2', 'Built for skateboarding, with durable construction for daily sessions.'],
    ['ACG', 'acg', 'Mountain Fly 2 Low|ACG Lowcate|ACG Jacket', 'For trails and all-conditions outings.'],
    ['Golf', 'golf', 'Victory Tour 3|Infinity Pro 2', 'Built for the course, from the first tee to the last green.'],
    ['Tennis', 'ten', 'Vapor Pro 3|Court Zoom Pro', 'For fast lateral movement on the court.'],
    ['Collabs', 'col', 'NOCTA Hoodie|Cactus Jack Hoodie|NikeSKIMS Bra|NikeSKIMS Tank', 'A collaboration piece from a partner line.'],
    ['Accessories', 'acc', 'Heritage Backpack|Brasilia Duffel|Heritage Cap|Everyday Crew Socks', 'Everyday carry and gear for training and travel.'],
  ];
  const slug = s => s.toLowerCase().replace(/'/g, '').replace(/\+/g, ' plus ').replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, '-').replace(/^-|-$/g, '');
  const ALL = DATA.flatMap(([label, code, list, blurb]) => list.split('|').map(name => ({ name, label, code, blurb })));
  ALL.forEach((p, i) => { p.n = String(i + 1).padStart(3, '0'); p.slug = 'p-' + slug(p.name); });

  // Intro loader: counts to 100, then lifts away and starts the hero
  const intro = $('#intro'), cnt = $('#cnt'), bar = $('#bar');
  const DUR = reduce ? 0 : 1800, t0 = performance.now();
  const tick = () => {
    const k = DUR ? clamp((performance.now() - t0) / DUR) : 1;
    cnt.textContent = String(Math.round(k * 100)).padStart(3, '0');
    bar.style.transform = `scaleX(${k})`;
    if (k < 1) { requestAnimationFrame(tick); return; }
    intro.classList.add('out');
    document.body.classList.add('ready');
    setTimeout(() => { intro.hidden = true; }, 1100);
  };
  requestAnimationFrame(tick);

  // Shop
  let cat = 'all', shopLoaded = false, pdTimer;
  const side = $('#side'), grid = $('#grid'), stitle = $('#shop-title');
  const TONES = [['#111111', '#F4F4F1', '#CEFF00'], ['#CEFF00', '#111111', '#F4F4F1'], ['#F4F4F1', '#111111', '#CEFF00'], ['#8C8C8A', '#111111', '#CEFF00']];
  // Illustrations by product type: generic silhouettes with details (not photos of the specific models)
  const SHAPES = {
    low:   { k: 'shoe', u: 'M24 110L22 56Q22 26 52 24L84 26Q92 52 118 60L150 72Q190 82 220 98Q226 104 222 110Z', s: 'M16 108L200 108Q228 110 224 122Q220 132 196 132L30 132Q14 132 16 108Z', m: 'M20 110L204 110Q218 112 214 120L24 120Z', l: 'M104 56L126 68M116 50L138 62M128 44L150 56', t: 'M40 128L60 128M80 128L100 128M120 128L140 128M160 128L180 128', c: 'M26 84Q120 74 216 98' },
    high:  { k: 'shoe', u: 'M28 112L26 40Q26 14 56 12L92 14Q100 40 124 52L150 66Q190 80 220 98Q226 104 222 112Z', s: 'M16 108L200 108Q228 110 224 122Q220 132 196 132L30 132Q14 132 16 108Z', m: 'M20 110L204 110Q218 112 214 120L24 120Z', l: 'M104 62L126 74M116 56L138 68M128 50L150 62', t: 'M40 128L60 128M80 128L100 128M120 128L140 128M160 128L180 128', c: 'M26 44Q52 52 92 44' },
    boot:  { k: 'shoe', u: 'M22 112L20 62Q22 40 50 40L88 44Q100 60 130 70L176 78Q212 86 226 104Q226 112 220 112Z', s: 'M14 112L226 112Q232 124 214 130L28 130Q12 128 14 112Z', m: 'M16 112L226 112L226 116L14 116Z', dots: [[40, 124], [80, 124], [120, 124], [160, 124], [200, 124]], c: 'M22 102Q120 96 224 106' },
    train: { k: 'shoe', u: 'M22 112L22 70Q24 50 50 48L96 50Q112 66 140 72L200 78Q222 84 224 100Q224 112 214 112Z', s: 'M18 112L222 112Q228 122 214 128L26 128Q16 126 18 112Z', m: 'M20 112L222 112L220 118L22 118Z', l: 'M110 58L132 66M124 52L146 60', t: 'M40 122L70 122M100 122L130 122M160 122L190 122', c: 'M24 92Q120 84 220 96' },
    hoodie:{ k: 'cloth', u: 'M78 30Q120 12 162 30L192 50L210 118Q212 132 198 132L42 132Q28 132 30 118L48 50Z', x: ['M96 30Q120 2 144 30', 'M82 100L158 100L164 124L76 124Z', 'M32 118Q120 126 208 118'] },
    tee:   { k: 'cloth', u: 'M86 26L60 44L30 60L44 96L70 88L70 132L170 132L170 88L196 96L210 60L180 44L154 26Q120 40 86 26Z', x: ['M104 30Q120 44 136 30'] },
    pants: { k: 'cloth', u: 'M70 20L170 20L178 132L132 132L120 62L108 132L62 132Z', x: ['M92 36L96 132'] },
    shorts:{ k: 'cloth', u: 'M50 22L190 22L200 132L136 132L120 70L104 132L40 132Z', x: ['M104 22Q120 34 136 22', 'M116 26L114 46'] },
    tank:  { k: 'cloth', u: 'M64 20L92 20Q120 46 148 20L176 20L184 130L56 130Z', x: ['M64 40L176 40'] },
    bra:   { k: 'cloth', u: 'M70 50Q120 80 170 50L180 90Q120 112 60 90Z', x: ['M120 66L120 84'] },
    bag:   { k: 'cloth', u: 'M60 40Q60 22 78 22L162 22Q180 22 180 40L184 128Q184 136 176 136L64 136Q56 136 56 128Z', x: ['M94 22Q94 4 120 4Q146 4 146 22', 'M78 70L162 70L162 118L78 118Z', 'M78 74L162 74'] },
    duffel:{ k: 'cloth', u: 'M30 60Q30 46 46 46L194 46Q210 46 210 60L210 110Q210 124 194 124L46 124Q30 124 30 110Z', x: ['M30 80L210 80', 'M96 46Q96 30 120 30Q144 30 144 46'] },
    cap:   { k: 'cloth', u: 'M52 100Q52 44 120 40Q188 44 188 100Z', f: ['M40 100Q120 118 200 100L200 108Q120 126 40 108Z'], x: ['M120 42L120 98'] },
    socks: { k: 'cloth', u: 'M86 16L150 16L150 96Q176 104 184 124Q188 136 170 136L92 136Q78 136 78 122L86 96Z', x: ['M84 40L152 40'] }
  };
  const shapeFor = p => {
    const n = p.name.toLowerCase();
    switch (p.code) {
      case 'fb': return 'boot';
      case 'tr': return 'train';
      case 'bb': return n.includes('g.t.') ? 'high' : 'low';
      case 'jor': return n.includes('low') ? 'low' : 'high';
      case 'acg': return n.includes('lowcate') ? 'low' : n.includes('jacket') ? 'hoodie' : 'high';
      case 'sw': return n.includes('tee') ? 'tee' : n.includes('shorts') ? 'shorts' : /joggers|pants/.test(n) ? 'pants' : 'hoodie';
      case 'col': return n.includes('bra') ? 'bra' : n.includes('tank') ? 'tank' : 'hoodie';
      case 'acc': return n.includes('backpack') ? 'bag' : n.includes('duffel') ? 'duffel' : n.includes('cap') ? 'cap' : 'socks';
      default: return 'low';
    }
  };
  const art = p => {
    const [body, sole, accent] = TONES[ALL.indexOf(p) % TONES.length];
    const S = SHAPES[shapeFor(p)], ink = '#111111';
    const line = (d, c, w) => `<path d="${d}" fill="none" stroke="${c}" stroke-width="${w}" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>`;
    let g = `<ellipse cx="120" cy="138" rx="98" ry="6" fill="${ink}" opacity=".14"/>`;
    if (S.k === 'shoe') {
      g += `<path d="${S.s}" fill="${sole}" stroke="${ink}" stroke-width="2"/><path d="${S.m}" fill="${accent}"/>`
        + `<path d="${S.u}" fill="${body}" stroke="${ink}" stroke-width="2"/>`;
      if (S.c) g += line(S.c, accent, 5);
      if (S.l) g += line(S.l, sole, 3);
      if (S.t) g += line(S.t, ink, 1.5);
      (S.dots || []).forEach(([x, y]) => { g += `<circle cx="${x}" cy="${y}" r="2.6" fill="${ink}"/>`; });
    } else {
      g += `<path d="${S.u}" fill="${body}" stroke="${ink}" stroke-width="2"/>`;
      (S.x || []).forEach(d => { g += line(d, accent, 4); });
      (S.f || []).forEach(d => { g += `<path d="${d}" fill="${accent}" stroke="${ink}" stroke-width="2"/>`; });
    }
    return `<svg class="shoe-art" viewBox="0 0 240 150" aria-hidden="true" focusable="false">${g}</svg>`;
  };
  const card = (p, i) => `<article class="card" data-slug="${p.slug}" style="--i:${i}"><a class="pic" href="#${p.slug}" aria-label="${p.name}">${art(p)}</a><div class="meta"><span class="n">${p.n}</span><h3><a href="#${p.slug}">${p.name}</a></h3><p>${p.label}</p><button class="add" type="button" data-add="${p.slug}">Add to cart</button></div></article>`;
  side.innerHTML = [['all', 'All', ALL.length], ...DATA.map(d => [d[1], d[0], d[2].split('|').length])]
    .map(([c, l, n]) => `<button type="button" data-cat="${c}" aria-pressed="false"><span>${l}</span><span>${n}</span></button>`).join('');
  side.addEventListener('click', e => {
    const b = e.target.closest('button');
    if (b) { cat = b.dataset.cat; drawShop(false); }
  });
  const drawShop = sk => {
    $$('button', side).forEach(b => b.setAttribute('aria-pressed', String(b.dataset.cat === cat)));
    stitle.textContent = cat === 'all' ? 'All' : DATA.find(d => d[1] === cat)[0];
    if (sk) { grid.innerHTML = '<div class="card ph"></div>'.repeat(9); return; }
    const before = new Map([...grid.querySelectorAll('.card[data-slug]')].map(el => [el.dataset.slug, el.getBoundingClientRect()]));
    grid.innerHTML = ALL.filter(p => cat === 'all' || p.code === cat).map((p, i) => card(p, i)).join('');
    if (!reduce) grid.querySelectorAll('.card[data-slug]').forEach(el => {
      const a = before.get(el.dataset.slug); if (!a) return;
      const b = el.getBoundingClientRect(), dx = a.left - b.left, dy = a.top - b.top;
      if (dx || dy) el.animate([{ transform: `translate(${dx}px,${dy}px)` }, { transform: 'none' }], { duration: 650, easing: 'cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.1,1)' });
    });
  };
  const showShop = () => {
    if (shopLoaded) return drawShop(false);
    drawShop(true);
    setTimeout(() => { shopLoaded = true; drawShop(false); }, 900);
  };

  // Product pages
  const pdHTML = p => {
    const i = ALL.indexOf(p), prev = ALL[(i + ALL.length - 1) % ALL.length], next = ALL[(i + 1) % ALL.length];
    const rel = ALL.filter(x => x.code === p.code && x !== p).slice(0, 4);
    return `<section class="pd-top pd-in"><p class="pd-meta"><span>${p.n}</span><span>${p.label}</span></p><div class="pd-art" data-slug="${p.slug}">${art(p)}</div><h1 class="pd-name">${p.name}</h1></section>
<section class="pd-body pd-in"><p class="pd-blurb">${p.blurb}</p><div><p class="pd-note">Price and availability are not part of this prototype. Check the official store for current details.</p><a class="btn btn-dark" href="#shop">Back to shop</a> <button class="btn btn-dark" type="button" data-add="${p.slug}" style="margin-left:12px">Add to cart</button></div></section>
<nav class="pd-nav pd-in" aria-label="Product pages"><a href="#${prev.slug}">Previous: ${prev.name}</a><a href="#${next.slug}">Next: ${next.name}</a></nav>
<section class="rel pd-in"><h2>More ${p.label}</h2><div class="grid">${rel.map((x, j) => card(x, j)).join('')}</div></section>`;
  };
  const showProduct = p => {
    const pd = $('#pd');
    pd.innerHTML = '<div class="pd-skel ph"></div>';
    clearTimeout(pdTimer);
    pdTimer = setTimeout(() => { pd.innerHTML = pdHTML(p); scramble($('.pd-name')); }, 500);
  };

  // Routing: the hash selects the view; product pages use #p-<model>
  const VIEWS = ['home', 'shop', 'sessions', 'pace', 'brand'];
  const route = () => {
    const h = location.hash.slice(1) || 'home';
    const p = h.startsWith('p-') ? ALL.find(x => x.slug === h) : null;
    const v = p ? 'product' : VIEWS.includes(h) ? h : 'home';
    $$('[data-view]').forEach(el => { el.hidden = el.dataset.view !== v; });
    $$('[data-tab]').forEach(a => a.setAttribute('aria-current', a.dataset.tab === (v === 'product' ? 'shop' : v) ? 'page' : 'false'));
    if (v === 'shop') showShop();
    if (v === 'product') showProduct(p);
    scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: 'instant' });
  };
  addEventListener('hashchange', () => { if (document.startViewTransition && !reduce) document.startViewTransition(route); else route(); });

  // Pace calculator
  const dist = $('#dist'), mins = $('#mins'), secs = $('#secs');
  const paceOut = $('#pace-out'), speedOut = $('#speed-out');
  const calc = () => {
    const d = parseFloat(dist.value);
    const t = (parseFloat(mins.value) || 0) * 60 + (parseFloat(secs.value) || 0);
    if (!(d > 0) || !(t > 0)) { paceOut.textContent = '—'; speedOut.textContent = '—'; return; }
    const ps = Math.round(t / d);
    paceOut.textContent = `${Math.floor(ps / 60)}:${String(ps % 60).padStart(2, '0')}`;
    speedOut.textContent = (d / (t / 3600)).toFixed(1);
  };
  [dist, mins, secs].forEach(i => i.addEventListener('input', calc));
  calc();

  // Palette: click to copy
  const copied = $('#copied');
  $$('.sw').forEach(b => b.addEventListener('click', async () => {
    const hex = b.dataset.hex;
    try { await navigator.clipboard.writeText(hex); copied.textContent = `${hex} copied.`; }
    catch { copied.textContent = hex; }
  }));

  // Magnetic CTAs (the pointer itself stays native)
  if (fine) $$('[data-mag]').forEach(el => {
    el.addEventListener('pointermove', e => {
      const r = el.getBoundingClientRect();
      el.style.transform = `translate(${(e.clientX - r.left - r.width / 2) * 0.3}px, ${(e.clientY - r.top - r.height / 2) * 0.35}px)`;
    });
    el.addEventListener('pointerleave', () => { el.style.transform = ''; });
  });

  // Home and sessions: marquee, hero, statement, pinned rail
  const home = $('[data-view="home"]'), sess = $('[data-view="sessions"]');
  const sessEl = $('.sessions'), rail = $('.rail'), title = $('.hero-title');
  const stroke = $('#stroke'), len = stroke.getTotalLength(), block = $('.statement');
  const track = $('.track');
  stroke.style.strokeDasharray = len;
  track.innerHTML += track.innerHTML;
  const st = $('#statement');
  st.innerHTML = st.textContent.trim().split(/\s+/).map(w => `<span class="w">${w}</span>`).join(' ');
  const words = $$('.w', st);
  words.forEach(w => { w.style.opacity = reduce ? 1 : 0.18; });

  let lastY = scrollY, dir = 1, mq = 0;
  const frame = () => {
    const y = scrollY, vel = y - lastY;
    lastY = y;
    if (Math.abs(vel) > 0.5) dir = vel > 0 ? 1 : -1;
    if (!reduce && !home.hidden) {
      const half = track.scrollWidth / 2;
      mq = (mq + dir * (0.6 + Math.min(Math.abs(vel) * 0.6, 40)) + half) % half;
      track.style.transform = `translate3d(${-mq}px,0,0)`;
      const p = clamp(y / innerHeight);
      title.style.fontVariationSettings = `"wdth" ${125 - p * 40}`;
      stroke.style.strokeDashoffset = len * (1 - clamp(0.35 + p * 0.65));
      const br = block.getBoundingClientRect();
      const bp = clamp((innerHeight * 0.9 - br.top) / (br.height + innerHeight * 0.4)) * words.length;
      words.forEach((w, i) => { w.style.opacity = (0.18 + 0.82 * clamp(bp - i)).toFixed(2); });
    }
    if (!reduce && !sess.hidden) {
      const sr = sessEl.getBoundingClientRect();
      const sp = clamp(-sr.top / (sessEl.offsetHeight - innerHeight));
      rail.style.transform = `translate3d(${-sp * (rail.scrollWidth - innerWidth)}px,0,0)`;
    }
    requestAnimationFrame(frame);
  };

  // Approximate model: decimated copy (about 55k triangles) of the uploaded Nike TC 7900 Sail geometry, one color per part.
  // Used only if the embedded model cannot be read on this device.
  const FALLBACK = {"s":20479.375,"prims":[{"c":"#000000","p":"","i":""},{"c":"#EDEDE9","p":"","i":""},{"c":"#E1E1E1","p":"","i":""},{"c":"#F1F1F0","p":"","i":""},{"c":"#EDEDE9","p":"","i":""},{"c":"#F1F1F0","p":"","i":""},{"c":"#F1F1EF","p":"","i":""},{"c":"#F1F1EF","p":"","i":""},{"c":"#F1F1F0","p":"","i":""},{"c":"#F1F1EF","p":"","i":""},{"c":"#EDEDE9","p":"","i":""},{"c":"#EDEDE9","p":"","i":""},{"c":"#EFEFED","p":"","i":""},{"c":"#F1F1EF","p":"","i":""},{"c":"#EDEDE9","p":"","i":""},{"c":"#EDEDE9","p":"","i":""}]};
  const buildFallback = pivot => {
    const toBuffer = s => { const r = atob(s), u = new Uint8Array(r.length); for (let i = 0; i < r.length; i++) u[i] = r.charCodeAt(i); return u.buffer; };
    const group = new THREE.Group();
    FALLBACK.prims.forEach(pr => {
      const q = new Int16Array(toBuffer(pr.p)), idx = new Uint16Array(toBuffer(pr.i));
      const pos = new Float32Array(q.length);
      for (let i = 0; i < q.length; i++) pos[i] = q[i] / FALLBACK.s;
      const g = new THREE.BufferGeometry();
      g.setAttribute('position', new THREE.BufferAttribute(pos, 3));
      g.setIndex(new THREE.BufferAttribute(idx, 1));
      g.computeVertexNormals();
      group.add(new THREE.Mesh(g, new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: pr.c, roughness: 0.5, metalness: 0.1, side: THREE.DoubleSide })));
    });
    group.traverse(o => { if (o.isMesh) { o.castShadow = true; o.receiveShadow = true; } });
    pivot.add(group);
  };

  // 3D sneaker in the hero: Sketchfab model "Nike TC 7900 Sail" (CC BY 4.0, see footer).
  // The GLB is read straight from the embedded data (no external loader); textures are decoded with createImageBitmap.
  const setStatus = t => { const s = $('#shoe-status'); if (s) s.textContent = t; };
  if (!window.THREE) {
    setStatus('3D library unavailable');
  } else {
    try {
      const box = $('#shoe'), hero = $('.hero');
      const R = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({ alpha: true, antialias: true });
      R.setPixelRatio(Math.min(devicePixelRatio, 2));
      R.outputEncoding = THREE.sRGBEncoding;
      R.shadowMap.enabled = true;
      R.shadowMap.type = THREE.PCFSoftShadowMap;
      box.appendChild(R.domElement);
      const scene = new THREE.Scene(), cam = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(30, 1, 0.1, 100);
      scene.add(new THREE.HemisphereLight(0xffffff, 0x333333, 1.0));
      const key = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xffffff, 1.4); key.position.set(3, 4, 5); key.castShadow = true;
      key.shadow.mapSize.set(2048, 2048);
      Object.assign(key.shadow.camera, { left: -2.5, right: 2.5, top: 2.5, bottom: -2.5, near: 0.5, far: 20 });
      key.shadow.camera.updateProjectionMatrix();
      key.shadow.bias = -0.0008; key.shadow.normalBias = 0.02;
      scene.add(key);
      const fill = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xCEFF00, 0.6); fill.position.set(-4, 2, -3); scene.add(fill);
      const ground = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.PlaneGeometry(12, 12), new THREE.ShadowMaterial({ opacity: 0.35 }));
      ground.rotation.x = -Math.PI / 2; ground.receiveShadow = true; ground.visible = false; scene.add(ground);
      const cv = document.createElement('canvas'); cv.width = cv.height = 256;
      const cx = cv.getContext('2d'), gr = cx.createRadialGradient(128, 128, 0, 128, 128, 128);
      gr.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(0,0,0,0.45)'); gr.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0,0,0,0)');
      cx.fillStyle = gr; cx.fillRect(0, 0, 256, 256);
      const contact = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.PlaneGeometry(2.8, 2.8), new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ map: new THREE.CanvasTexture(cv), transparent: true, depthWrite: false }));
      contact.rotation.x = -Math.PI / 2; contact.visible = false; scene.add(contact);
      // Rest the shadow on the lowest point of the tilted shoe (spinning around Y does not change it)
      const placeGround = () => {
        pivot.updateMatrixWorld(true);
        const low = new THREE.Box3().setFromObject(pivot).min.y;
        ground.position.y = low; contact.position.y = low + 0.005;
        ground.visible = true; contact.visible = true;
      };
      const pivot = new THREE.Group(); pivot.rotation.order = 'YXZ'; scene.add(pivot);
      const fit = () => {
        const w = box.clientWidth, h = box.clientHeight;
        R.setSize(w, h); cam.aspect = w / h; cam.position.set(0, 0.3, w / h < 1 ? 9 : 6); cam.lookAt(0, 0, 0);
        cam.updateProjectionMatrix();
      };
      fit(); addEventListener('resize', fit);
      let cur = 0.4;
      const spin = () => {
        cur += (scrollY / innerHeight * Math.PI * 2 + 0.4 - cur) * 0.12;
        pivot.rotation.set(0.22, cur, 0);
        if (!home.hidden && hero.getBoundingClientRect().bottom > 0) R.render(scene, cam);
        requestAnimationFrame(spin);
      };
      spin();
      setStatus('Loading 3D model...');
      (async () => {
        try {
          const bin = atob($('#glb').textContent.trim());
          const bytes = new Uint8Array(bin.length);
          for (let i = 0; i < bin.length; i++) bytes[i] = bin.charCodeAt(i);
          const jl = new DataView(bytes.buffer).getUint32(12, true);
          const G = JSON.parse(new TextDecoder().decode(bytes.subarray(20, 20 + jl)));
          const base = 28 + jl;
          const views = G.bufferViews.map(v => ({ o: base + (v.byteOffset || 0), n: v.byteLength }));
          const TA = { 5120: Int8Array, 5121: Uint8Array, 5122: Int16Array, 5123: Uint16Array, 5125: Uint32Array, 5126: Float32Array };
          const NC = { SCALAR: 1, VEC2: 2, VEC3: 3, VEC4: 4 };
          const acc = i => {
            const a = G.accessors[i], T = TA[a.componentType], v = views[a.bufferView], s = v.o + (a.byteOffset || 0);
            return new T(bytes.buffer.slice(s, s + a.count * NC[a.type] * T.BYTES_PER_ELEMENT));
          };
          const imgs = await Promise.all(G.images.map(im => {
            const v = views[im.bufferView];
            return createImageBitmap(new Blob([bytes.subarray(v.o, v.o + v.n)], { type: im.mimeType }));
          }));
          const tex = (info, srgb) => {
            if (!info) return null;
            const t = new THREE.Texture(imgs[G.textures[info.index].source]);
            t.flipY = false; t.wrapS = t.wrapT = THREE.RepeatWrapping; t.needsUpdate = true;
            if (srgb) t.encoding = THREE.sRGBEncoding;
            return t;
          };
          const mats = G.materials.map(m => {
            const p = m.pbrMetallicRoughness || {}, c = p.baseColorFactor || [1, 1, 1, 1];
            const mat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
              color: new THREE.Color(c[0], c[1], c[2]),
              metalness: p.metallicFactor ?? 1, roughness: p.roughnessFactor ?? 1,
              side: m.doubleSided ? THREE.DoubleSide : THREE.FrontSide
            });
            const mr = tex(p.metallicRoughnessTexture, false);
            mat.map = tex(p.baseColorTexture, true); mat.metalnessMap = mr; mat.roughnessMap = mr;
            mat.normalMap = tex(m.normalTexture, false);
            if (m.alphaMode === 'MASK') mat.alphaTest = m.alphaCutoff ?? 0.5;
            return mat;
          });
          const build = ni => {
            const n = G.nodes[ni], o = new THREE.Object3D();
            if (n.matrix) new THREE.Matrix4().fromArray(n.matrix).decompose(o.position, o.quaternion, o.scale);
            if (n.translation) o.position.fromArray(n.translation);
            if (n.rotation) o.quaternion.fromArray(n.rotation);
            if (n.scale) o.scale.fromArray(n.scale);
            if (n.mesh !== undefined) G.meshes[n.mesh].primitives.forEach(pr => {
              const g = new THREE.BufferGeometry(), A = pr.attributes;
              g.setAttribute('position', new THREE.BufferAttribute(acc(A.POSITION), 3));
              if (A.NORMAL !== undefined) g.setAttribute('normal', new THREE.BufferAttribute(acc(A.NORMAL), 3));
              if (A.TEXCOORD_0 !== undefined) g.setAttribute('uv', new THREE.BufferAttribute(acc(A.TEXCOORD_0), 2));
              if (pr.indices !== undefined) g.setIndex(new THREE.BufferAttribute(acc(pr.indices), 1));
              o.add(new THREE.Mesh(g, mats[pr.material] || new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0xcccccc })));
            });
            (n.children || []).forEach(c => o.add(build(c)));
            return o;
          };
          const model = new THREE.Group();
          (G.scenes[G.scene || 0].nodes || []).forEach(ni => model.add(build(ni)));
          const bounds = new THREE.Box3().setFromObject(model);
          const center = bounds.getCenter(new THREE.Vector3()), dim = bounds.getSize(new THREE.Vector3());
          model.position.sub(center);
          const wrap = new THREE.Group(); wrap.add(model);
          wrap.scale.setScalar(3.2 / Math.max(dim.x, dim.y, dim.z));
          wrap.traverse(o => { if (o.isMesh) { o.castShadow = true; o.receiveShadow = true; } });
          pivot.add(wrap);
          placeGround();
          setStatus('');
        } catch (err) {
          buildFallback(pivot);
          placeGround();
          setStatus('Approximate model (embedded model failed: ' + (err && err.message ? err.message : err) + ')');
        }
      })();
    } catch (err) {
      setStatus('WebGL error: ' + (err && err.message ? err.message : err));
    }
  }

  // Cart: drag a product image onto the cart, or press Add to cart. Feedback: flight, bump, badge pop, toast.
  const cartBtn = $('#cart-btn'), cartPanel = $('#cart-panel'), cartList = $('#cart-list');
  const badge = $('#badge'), toast = $('#toast'), cartEmpty = $('#cart-empty'), cartTotal = $('#cart-total');
  const items = new Map();
  const inCart = (x, y) => { const b = cartBtn.getBoundingClientRect(); return x > b.left && x < b.right && y > b.top && y < b.bottom; };
  const drawCart = () => {
    const n = [...items.values()].reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0);
    badge.textContent = n;
    cartEmpty.hidden = n > 0;
    cartTotal.textContent = n ? `${n} ${n === 1 ? 'item' : 'items'}` : '';
    cartList.innerHTML = [...items].map(([slug, q]) => `<li><span>${ALL.find(x => x.slug === slug).name}</span><span>× ${q}</span><button type="button" data-remove="${slug}">Remove</button></li>`).join('');
  };
  const srcOf = el => (el.closest('[data-slug]') || el.closest('main')).querySelector('.pic, .pd-art') || el;
  const flyTo = (src, p) => {
    const a = src.getBoundingClientRect(), b = cartBtn.getBoundingClientRect();
    const g = document.createElement('div');
    g.className = 'fly';
    g.innerHTML = art(p);
    Object.assign(g.style, { left: a.left + 'px', top: a.top + 'px', width: a.width + 'px' });
    document.body.appendChild(g);
    const dx = (b.left + b.width / 2) - (a.left + a.width / 2), dy = (b.top + b.height / 2) - (a.top + a.height / 2);
    g.animate([
      { transform: 'translate(0,0) scale(1)', opacity: 1 },
      { transform: `translate(${dx * 0.5}px, ${dy * 0.5 - 90}px) scale(0.7)`, opacity: 0.95, offset: 0.45 },
      { transform: `translate(${dx}px, ${dy}px) scale(0.15)`, opacity: 0 }
    ], { duration: 760, easing: 'cubic-bezier(.5,0,.2,1)' }).onfinish = () => g.remove();
  };
  const add = (slug, src) => {
    const p = ALL.find(x => x.slug === slug);
    items.set(slug, (items.get(slug) || 0) + 1);
    drawCart();
    flyTo(src, p);
    setTimeout(() => {
      cartBtn.animate([{ transform: 'scale(1)' }, { transform: 'scale(1.16)' }, { transform: 'scale(0.94)' }, { transform: 'scale(1)' }], { duration: 480, easing: 'ease-out' });
      badge.animate([{ transform: 'scale(1.9)' }, { transform: 'scale(1)' }], { duration: 380, easing: 'cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.1,1)' });
    }, 640);
    toast.textContent = `Added to cart: ${p.name}`;
    toast.classList.remove('show'); void toast.offsetWidth; toast.classList.add('show');
  };
  let drag = null, justDragged = false;
  document.addEventListener('pointerdown', e => {
    justDragged = false;
    const pic = e.button === 0 && e.target.closest?.('.card .pic, .pd-art');
    if (!pic) return;
    drag = { pic, slug: pic.closest('[data-slug]').dataset.slug, x: e.clientX, y: e.clientY, ghost: null };
    pic.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId);
  });
  document.addEventListener('pointermove', e => {
    if (!drag) return;
    if (!drag.ghost) {
      if (Math.hypot(e.clientX - drag.x, e.clientY - drag.y) < 8) return;
      const r = drag.pic.getBoundingClientRect();
      drag.ghost = document.createElement('div');
      drag.ghost.className = 'fly';
      drag.ghost.innerHTML = art(ALL.find(x => x.slug === drag.slug));
      drag.ghost.style.width = r.width + 'px';
      drag.ox = e.clientX - r.left; drag.oy = e.clientY - r.top;
      document.body.appendChild(drag.ghost);
    }
    drag.ghost.style.transform = `translate(${e.clientX - drag.ox}px, ${e.clientY - drag.oy}px) rotate(-5deg)`;
    cartBtn.classList.toggle('over', inCart(e.clientX, e.clientY));
  });
  const endDrag = e => {
    if (!drag) return;
    const d = drag; drag = null;
    cartBtn.classList.remove('over');
    if (!d.ghost) return;
    justDragged = true;
    if (inCart(e.clientX, e.clientY)) { add(d.slug, d.ghost); d.ghost.remove(); }
    else d.ghost.animate([{ opacity: 1 }, { opacity: 0 }], { duration: 220 }).onfinish = () => d.ghost.remove();
  };
  document.addEventListener('pointerup', endDrag);
  document.addEventListener('pointercancel', endDrag);
  document.addEventListener('click', e => {
    if (justDragged) { e.preventDefault(); e.stopPropagation(); justDragged = false; }
  }, true);
  document.addEventListener('dragstart', e => { if (e.target.closest?.('.pic, .pd-art')) e.preventDefault(); });
  cartBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
    cartPanel.hidden = !cartPanel.hidden;
    cartBtn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', String(!cartPanel.hidden));
  });
  document.addEventListener('click', e => {
    const a = e.target.closest('[data-add]');
    if (a) return add(a.dataset.add, srcOf(a));
    const r = e.target.closest('[data-remove]');
    if (r) { items.delete(r.dataset.remove); drawCart(); }
  });
  drawCart();

  // Added: progress bar, parallax, split headings, card tilt, text decode
  const prog = document.createElement('div');
  prog.className = 'progress';
  document.body.appendChild(prog);
  const hf = $('.hero-foot');
  addEventListener('scroll', () => {
    const max = document.documentElement.scrollHeight - innerHeight || 1;
    prog.style.transform = `scaleX(${Math.min(1, scrollY / max).toFixed(4)})`;
    if (reduce) return;
    const pa = $('#pd .pd-art');
    if (pa) pa.style.transform = `translate3d(0,${Math.min(scrollY * 0.12, 120).toFixed(1)}px,0)`;
    if (hf && !home.hidden) hf.style.transform = `translate3d(0,${Math.min(scrollY * 0.22, 160).toFixed(1)}px,0)`;
  }, { passive: true });

  const splitEls = $$('[data-split]');
  splitEls.forEach(el => {
    const txt = el.textContent.trim();
    el.setAttribute('aria-label', txt);
    el.innerHTML = [...txt].map((c, i) => `<span class="ch" aria-hidden="true" style="--d:${i * 22}ms">${c === ' ' ? '&nbsp;' : c}</span>`).join('');
  });
  const io = new IntersectionObserver(entries => entries.forEach(en => {
    if (en.isIntersecting) { en.target.classList.add('in'); io.unobserve(en.target); }
  }), { threshold: 0.3 });
  splitEls.forEach(el => (reduce ? el.classList.add('in') : io.observe(el)));

  if (fine) {
    document.addEventListener('pointermove', e => {
      const c = e.target.closest?.('.card:not(.ph)');
      if (!c) return;
      const r = c.getBoundingClientRect(), x = (e.clientX - r.left) / r.width, y = (e.clientY - r.top) / r.height;
      c.style.setProperty('--ry', ((x - 0.5) * 12).toFixed(2) + 'deg');
      c.style.setProperty('--rx', ((0.5 - y) * 12).toFixed(2) + 'deg');
      c.style.setProperty('--mx', (x * 100).toFixed(1) + '%');
      c.style.setProperty('--my', (y * 100).toFixed(1) + '%');
    }, { passive: true });
    document.addEventListener('pointerout', e => {
      const c = e.target.closest?.('.card');
      if (c && !c.contains(e.relatedTarget)) { c.style.setProperty('--rx', '0deg'); c.style.setProperty('--ry', '0deg'); }
    });
  }

  const scramble = el => {
    if (!el || reduce) return;
    const final = el.textContent, pool = 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ0123456789/+-';
    let f = 0;
    const t = setInterval(() => {
      f++;
      el.textContent = [...final].map((c, i) => (c === ' ' || i < f / 2.2) ? c : pool[Math.random() * pool.length | 0]).join('');
      if (f > final.length * 2.2 + 2) { clearInterval(t); el.textContent = final; }
    }, 32);
  };

  // Shop categories side index is sticky; grid tiles reveal with stagger
  route();
  requestAnimationFrame(frame);
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>
